items.title: Lattice energy and charge on the ions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Lattice energy and charge on the ions: a main subheading of 6.9.2 Lattice energy, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 132-132.

blocks.text: Lattice energy ions ke charge ke directly proportional (seedhi nisbat mein) hai: ion par charge jitna zyada, lattice energy utni zyada, aur ulta bhi. Ise samajhne ke liye lithium fluoride (LiF) aur magnesium oxide (MgO) ka comparison karte hain.
Dono compounds ki lattice mein ions ka arrangement (tarteeb) ek jaisa hai, aur dono mein cations aur anions ke size bhi taqreeban ek jaise hain.
LiF aur MgO mein bara farq ions ke charge ka hai, jo lattice energy par asar dalta hai.
Magnesium oxide ki ΔHlatt [MgO] = –3923 kJ mol⁻¹ hai, jo lithium fluoride ki ΔHlatt [LiF] = –1049 kJ mol⁻¹ se kahin zyada hai.

MgO ke do charge wale Mg²⁺ aur O²⁻ ions ek doosre ko LiF ke ek charge wale (aur usi size ke) ions se zyada zor se khainchte hain. Ek jaise size ke ions mein charge zyada ho to charge density zyada hoti hai, aur ionic bonds zyada mazboot bante hain.
